title: Polarizing the complex Stinespring center yields a positive inverse-Choi SDP

statement.quantifiers: Finite channel, unnormalized Choi J with TrB J=I, pseudoinverse J+, minimal Kraus/Stinespring dilation.
statement.assertion: Centered Gram factor eta=1-1/M; M minimizes ||TrB[(I tensor sigma)J+(I tensor sigma)]|| over densities satisfying ran(I tensor sigma) subset ranJ, equivalently the displayed block SDP.
assumptions: Start with complex H,TrH=1, correct adjoint/vectorization conventions.

inputs: Precisely specified operators, quantum channel/pure family and source hypotheses.
outputs: Scoped analytical reduction/candidate assertion with source review boundary.

proof_mechanism: Kraus vectorization solves the range equation with J+.
H->|H|/Tr|H| preserves range and lowers norm; Schur complement gives SDP.
obstructions: Ignoring range condition at singular Choi invalidates formula.
Positive center is derived; signed lift itself need not be positive.
